title: Certificação Técnica de Interoperabilidade BANZA v1.0
canonical_decision: BANZA technically certifies that a concrete implementation (operator + implementation + environment + profile + protocol version + capabilities + evidence + validity window) demonstrated conformance with a public, versioned interoperability profile. Determined by verifiable Rust engines from public, reproducible, time-bounded, revocable evidence. NOT a financial licence, regulatory authorisation, commercial approval or institutional guarantee. No CA, no discretionary human approval, no Qwen in the decision path.
supersedes_or_amends: ADR-040 (Federation Trust Evaluation Without Certificates) — amended: adds evidence-based technical certification records, still without a CA
public 'BANZA nunca certifica' absolute framing — replaced by the qualified technical-interop-certification framing
preserves: PASS = verifiable evidence not a licence
